# Yashashwi Singhania

> The official portfolio of Yashashwi Singhania, an IIT (BHU) dual-degree student building reinforcement-learning projects, systems software, and native macOS apps.

## Portfolio
- [Selected work](https://yashashwi.me/#work): Projects, source repositories, experience, and achievements.
- [Curriculum vitae](https://cv.yashashwi.me/): Education, experience, and technical skills.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/yashashwi-s): Public source repositories and contributions.

## Native macOS Apps
- [PureMac](https://puremac.yashashwi.me/): The official catalog of independent, open-source Mac apps.
- [Arras](https://arras.yashashwi.me/): Desktop photo widgets that preserve each image's aspect ratio; includes downloads and installation instructions.
- [Fadeo](https://puremac.yashashwi.me/fadeo): Rule-driven workflow audio for macOS; includes features and licensing details.
